title: Polynomial-Time Closure Under Word Mapping
statement: If $g$ is a polynomial-time computable function on bit strings, then the following function is polynomial-time computable: encode the two decoded components of the input as an initial pair, and repeatedly apply the prescribed pair update for $|z|+2$ iterations, concatenate the resulting mapped chunks, and return the resulting bit string.
